Bill.BriefDescription: Changing provisions pertaining to third-party custody proceedings involving the Indian Child Welfare Act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to thirdparty custody proceedings involving theIndian Child Welfare Act; and adding a new section to chapter 26.10RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every petition filed in proceedings under this chapter shallcontain a statement alleging whether the child is or may be an Indianchild as defined in 25 U.S.C. Sec. 1903. If the child is an Indianchild as defined under the Indian child welfare act, the provisions ofthe act shall apply. (2) Every order or decree entered in any proceeding under thischapter shall contain a finding that the Indian child welfare act does or does not apply. Where there is a finding that the Indian childwelfare act does apply, the decree or order must also contain a findingthat all notice requirements and evidentiary requirements under theIndian child welfare act have been satisfied.
